name: Wonderful
source:
In Wonderful, you are a guy who made his fortune very young but who also lost everything very early.

In debt you return to your mother, on the road you will find a kitsune saying she comes from another world, find the truth about this world and this kistune.
translation:
在《奇妙》中，你是一个很年轻就发家致富，但也很早就失去一切的人。

负债累累的你回到母亲身边，路上你会发现一只狐，说她来自另一个世界，找到这个世界和这个狐的真相。
